title: CNF encoding of configuration validity
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. The configuration-validity CNF over the encoding bits consists of one-hot constraints selecting an input-head position and a state, one one-hot constraint selecting a position on each work tape, clauses forbidding the two designated bits at any work-tape position from both being true, and a clause forbidding both summary bits from being true.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
